Boston Urban Gardeners records

collection

This collection includes folders of materials on Chinatown from the 1980s, such as surveys (business, housing, user), reports (land use), plans, maps (Downtown Crossing and Chinatown), and a publication ("Chinatown 1988: Urban Design for Community Growth")
